metadata.gitb:name: DHA HIE APIs: Authentication and Client Registry
metadata.gitb:description: Checks that an EMR or facility system calls the DHA AfyaConnect HIE token endpoint (POST /tenants/token) and Client Registry lookup (GET /patients) as published at https://afyaconnect.dha.go.ke/hie-api. The test bed stands in for the HIE: it records each EMR call, forwards it to the configured HIE upstream (hieBaseUrl: mock-hie now, local UAT later), relays the reply and then checks the call.

gitb:actor.gitb:name: EMR / facility system
gitb:actor.gitb:desc: The system under test: an EMR that obtains an access token and looks up clients in the Client Registry.

gitb:actor.gitb:name: DHA HIE (simulated)
gitb:actor.gitb:desc: The HIE middleware, played by the test bed and backed by hieBaseUrl.
